title: Turning Text into Spectra: An NLP-Based Big Data Analysis to Replicate the Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (HiTOP) Framework Using Public and Anonymized Forum Posts
summary:
Many people share their experiences of mental distress in public online groups, including loneliness, low mood, anxiety, or problems with alcohol or other substances. This study aims to examine whether broader patterns can be identified, summarized, and better understood from these large amounts of textual data.

For this purpose, approximately 80,000 publicly accessible posts from relevant Reddit groups will be analyzed. The cleaned texts will then be comprehensively examined using computer-assisted language analysis, as well as human expert knowledge and feedback.

The aim is to derive a comprehensible and theoretically plausible understanding from unstructured and extensive free-text data of how symptoms relate to one another.

interventions.name: Single-arm, non-interventional secondary data analysis of publicly accessible and anonymous online forum posts. No study participants are recruited, interviewed, or treated. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
In this study, no individuals are recruited and no study participants are actively involved. Recruitment therefore refers to the process of secondary data collection. This process is based exclusively on previously published, publicly accessible text posts from predefined (sub)Reddit forums. There is no interaction with individuals in the forums. Users are neither contacted, observed, surveyed, nor otherwise involved in the study.

Thus, the analysis refers exclusively to the qualitative text entries. For each included post, only the year of collection, the post title, and the post content are extracted. In addition, a random post ID is assigned locally. Direct identifiers, usernames, profile data, comment histories, or any other person-related contextual information are explicitly not collected. Therefore, multiple posts are also not linked across individuals or over time.

Inclusion criteria
- The text post originates from predefined, publicly accessible Reddit forums with a clear connection to mental health topics.

- The post was published within the study period from 01.01.2010 to 01.08.2026.

- The post is text-based and contains at least 60 words.

- The post contains an explicit description of experiences, feelings, distress, coping, help-seeking, or everyday experiences in connection with psychological distress or mental health conditions.

- The post is publicly accessible at the time of data collection and has not been deleted, removed, or made inaccessible by the platform.
Exclusion criteria:
The following text posts will not be included: 

- Posts that consist exclusively or predominantly of images, videos, audio content, GIFs, memes, screenshots, surveys, or other non-text-based content.

- Posts that consist exclusively or predominantly of web links, quotations, news articles, scientific sources, documents, or other external sources.

- Posts without sufficient relevance to subjective experience in the context of psychological distress or mental health conditions.

- Posts that primarily contain advertising, spam, recruitment calls, surveys, petitions, commercial content, or content that appears automated.
